newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to trade Tower Semiconductor, Veritas options.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to trade Tower Semiconductor, Veritas options.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Friday it would list options on Tower Semiconductor Ltd and Veritas DGC Inc on January 8.
The exchange said Tower options will have opening strike prices of 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2, with initial expirations in February, March, April and July.
The stock was up 5/8 at 11 Friday afternoon.
Veritas options will open with strikes of 15, 17-1/2 and 20, with initial expirations in February, March, May and August, it said.
Veritas shares were up one at 18.
Group One Ltd will be the specialist unit for Tower options and Susquehanna Investment Group will be the specialist for Veritas.
